watch.summary: The creator spectates a player disguised as a wall painting who miraculously survives a flurry of close-range gunshots.

beats.what: Creator predicts the spectated player hiding on the wall is about to get caught.
Enemies shoot furiously at the wall right next to the disguised player.
The spectated player somehow survives the entire barrage without taking damage.
Creator reacts in wide-eyed shock and disbelief.
Creator bursts out laughing, asking how the player is still alive.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: How is this guy not dead?
watch.why: The creator's confident prediction of the player's demise is instantly subverted by a ridiculous stroke of luck. His wide-eyed, genuine disbelief perfectly mirrors the viewer's reaction.
